GAME_IDENTITY.binding_status: IDENTIFIED, NOT BOUND — these ids give a future result-binding pass a real key to archive-verify against; they do not themselves bind.
GAME_IDENTITY.inference_refused: The 8/28 ESPN ids run contiguously 401816702-401816716 with 8/29 siblings at exactly +15, so the ten missing gamePks could have been 'reconstructed' by adjacency. They were not. Precedent: the INFERRED 8/27 pk 825038 was archive-verified on 2026-08-28 to be a fabrication (real AZ@SF id 823179).
GAME_IDENTITY.namespace_is_load_bearing: MLB_GAMEPK and ESPN_GAMEID are different id spaces that both look like integers. Stripping the prefix to obtain a bare int reproduces the 8/27 defect in a new form. Consumers must branch on id_space and never join across spaces.
GAME_IDENTITY.pseudo_pk_contract: RETIRED for this date. Prior boards keyed rows on invented 827000-series integers shaped like gamePks; those keys could not bind a result and are the enabling condition RJ-007 found.

mlb:COL@ATL.detail: an early snippet put Sugano on ATL and another reported ATL as TBD; two later independent snippets gave Sugano (COL) vs Holmes (ATL) with consistent stat lines. Majority carried, not confirmed.

mlb:CWS@MIN.detail: Kremer (CWS) / Castillo (MIN) is single-source and puts both pitchers on clubs differing from their pre-2026 teams. It comes from the same source whose PIT@STL line was verified side-swapped. Re-confirm BOTH sides at T-90.

mlb:MIA@WSH.detail: Eury Perez — a Marlins-associated arm — is asserted as the WASHINGTON starter while MIAMI is TBD. Same shape as the confirmed PIT@STL swap. If the side is wrong, the home slot holds the away team's pitcher and the away slot is empty. Re-confirm at T-90.

mlb:PIT@STL.detail: the source reported 'Cardinals: Jared Jones / Pirates: Quinn Mathews'; a dedicated verification pass established Jones starts for PIT and Mathews for STL. The board carries the corrected sides. The uncorrected version would have mis-attributed both.

IDENTITY_RISK_REGISTER.why_separate: a wrong SIDE is not a missing NAME. Folding it into a starter class would understate it; folding it into the dose would silently move a probability. It is disclosed here and left visible.

mlb_home.unchanged_because: no canonical result exists after 2026-08-21; later finals are relayed/derived, not canonical
